breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that using the arithmetic-mean area for the calculation is an incorrect simplification. The ground truth prompt resolves this by omitting the incorrect instruction. The generated specification explicitly corrects this by stating, 'Do not replace A(x) with an arithmetic-mean area; use the exact function A(x) within the integral.' This aligns perfectly with the ground truth's intent.
